import{expect,test,beforeAll,beforeEach,afterEach,afterAll}from'vitest'
const emit=(phase,local)=>console.log('EXPECT_STATE_ROW '+JSON.stringify({kind:'inheritance',phase,global:expect.getState().environment,local:local?.getState().environment??null}))
emit('collection-before')
expect.setState({environment:'collection-authored'})
beforeAll(()=>{emit('beforeAll');expect.setState({environment:'beforeAll-authored'})})
beforeEach(()=>{emit('beforeEach-before');expect.setState({environment:'beforeEach-authored'})})
test('real local state inheritance',({expect:local})=>{emit('body-before',local);local.setState({environment:'local-authored'});emit('local-written',local);expect.setState({environment:'body-global-authored'});emit('global-written',local)})
afterEach(()=>emit('afterEach'))
afterAll(()=>emit('afterAll'))

qualification.scope: actual resolved environment field/value/presence and ordered authored/provider effects, genuine case counts/statuses
qualification.open: early run-error serialization, raw frames, unmeasured DOM provider and full ExpectStatic remain separate
